新闻报道 1 你有没有注意到你对你的朋友是怎样的？
News Report 1 Have you noticed how similar you are to your friends?
这可能是因为你的大脑运作和谐相处。
It may be because your brains operate in harmony with each other.
我们知道朋友更有可能年龄、性别、种族背景相同彼此一样。
We know that friends are more likely to be the same age, gender, and ethnic background as each other.
现在看来他们的大脑也很相似。
Now it seems their brains are alike too.
加州大学的研究人员扫描了42 名同学观看视频时的大脑旨在激起不同的反应。
Researchers at the University of California scanned the brains of 42 classmates while they watched videos intended to provoke varying responses.
有些人可能会觉得浪漫的场景很感人，例如，而其他人可能会觉得令人尷尬。
Some people might find a romantic scene touching, for instance, while others would feel it was embarrassing.
朋友之间的大脑活动更加相似而不是那些彼此不认识的人其他，特别是涉及注意力、情绪、和语言。
The activity of friends' brains was more similar than that of people who didn't know each other, particularly in regions involved in attention, emotion, and language.
这种相似性足够强烈，以至于用来预测两个人是否无论是否已经是朋友。
This similarity was strong enough that it could be used to predict whether two people were already friends or not.
这种关系可能是双向的。
The relationship probably goes two ways.
我们被那些有同样想法的人所吸引我们。
We are drawn to people who think like us.
然后我们会随着时间的推移影响他们的想法，可能会推动他们的大脑活动更加紧密地类似于我们自己的。
We then influence their thoughts over time, which may push their brain activity into more closely resembling our own.
新闻报道2.
News report 2.
两位男士多年来一直是最好的朋友60 年才意识到他们实际上兄弟。
Two men who have been best friends for 60 years have just realized they are actually brothers.
据报道，艾伦·罗宾逊和沃尔特·麦克唐纳在学校六年级时认识的在夏威夷。
It's reported that Alan Robinson and Walter McDonald met in the 6th grade at a school in Hawaii.
从此以后他们就成了最好的朋友。
They have been best friends ever since.
艾伦被送去领养他出生了，而沃尔特从来不知道他的父亲。
Alan was given away for adoption soon after he was born, and Walter never knew his father.
最近，他们分别尝试了 DNA匹配的网站来发现更多关于他们的祖先的信息。
So recently, they made separate attempts on DNA matching websites to discover more about their ancestry.
沃尔特惊讶地发现他匹配与网站用户 Robbie737 一起。
Walter was astonished to find that he matched with website user Robbie737.
他立刻意识到这是他最好的朋友艾伦（他的朋友都叫他罗比）当他还是一名飞行员的时候，曾驾驶过 737 架飞机。
He knew immediately that this was his best friend Alan, whose friends call him Robbie, and flew 737 airplanes when he was a pilot.
她们是同一个母亲所生相隔15个月。
The pair were born to the same mother 15 months apart.
新闻报道3.
News report 3.
在选举闹剧中，空气污染问题和疾病爆发，五位游客的善举是正在网上传播。
Amid all the election drama, air pollution problems and disease outbreaks, five tourists' good work is being spread online.
昨天，两名男性和三名女性游客发现在公里长的海滩上散步捡起垃圾。
Yesterday, two male and three female tourists were spotted walking the kilometer-long beach picking up trash.
一名来自澳大利亚的男性游客评论道尽管有很多垃圾，没人做任何事。
One of the male tourists from Australia commented that although there was a lot of trash, nobody was doing anything.
海滩不太好，也不太漂亮理所当然。
The beach was not as nice or beautiful as it should be.
他感到很难过美丽的地方却遍布着这么多垃圾。
He felt so sad to see such a gorgeous place littered with so much trash.
因此，他和他的朋友们决定抓住几个垃圾袋，然后清理干净向上。
Thus, he and his friends decided to grab a few trash bags and clean it all up.
一名路过的男子决定拍摄他们的好事并发布到网上。
A man passing by decided to video their good deed and put it on the internet.
目前还不清楚但他们很可能一起旅行。
It was unclear where the rest of the group was from, but they were most likely travelling together.
一名当地妇女表示，她感到很尴尬游客们正在清理海滩。
One local woman commented on being embarrassed that tourists were cleaning up their beach.
另一个人提到，这实际上是当地人带来食物和饮料，然后留下垃圾遍布整个岛屿。
Another mentioned that it was actually the natives who brought food and drinks, then left trash all along the island.
